title: Build NYC data ingestion and normalized map model
acceptance: tools/map_compiler contains a reproducible Python project with import adapters for pinned official NYC street/road geometry and OpenStreetMap road semantics
all imported geometry is normalized into a documented meter-based project coordinate system with explicit source CRS/unit conversion and a fixed NYC project origin

the normalized road model can represent road identifiers, roadbed/surface geometry, directionality, lane metadata, road class, and bridge/tunnel/layer semantics without requiring browser-side GIS parsing
source snapshots, acquisition instructions, licenses/attribution requirements, and transformation provenance are documented without committing impractically large raw city datasets
automated compiler tests cover projection/unit conversion and representative source normalization
verification: PR #2 merged into main as 72e37a7b41676bfcfb5d723c75500bbb94126a22 after clean GitHub-hosted verification. The map-compiler workflow installed pinned pyproj 3.7.2, Shapely 2.1.2, and pytest 9.0.2 and reported 7 passed in 0.21s. Existing web runtime, project health, and lint/schema checks also passed.

evidence.work: NYC/OSM normalization compiler, source lock, provenance documentation, and automated tests merged via PR #2
